messages:
Emma: Hey team — quick question. I opened #3452 to update the SDK snippets and added CODEOWNERS approval (docs/** @docs). The PR shows all checks passing but auto-merge is still blocked. Anyone know what gating we're enforcing for docs PRs now?

Sam: Which checks are reporting as passed? sometimes the check name mismatch trips auto-merge.

Emma: GitHub shows: \"All checks have passed\" but the auto-merge button is greyed. The checks list includes \"ci/docs-preview\" (green) and \"unit-tests\" (skipped). CODEOWNERS review was requested and Lina approved.

Mike: Two quick possibilities: 1) our auto-merge app expects a check named exactly \"docs/preview\" (not ci/docs-preview) — mismatch prevents the app from recognizing success. 2) The repo has \"Require linear history\" and the auto-merge bot can't rebase.

Lina: Also confirm that the PR has the label \"docs:automerge\" — we gate auto-merge on that label after the CODEOWNERS approval. Forgot to mention that in the docs.

Emma: Ah okay. I didn't add the label. Is that documented somewhere? I tried searching but only found the old automation notes.

Sam: Not well documented right now. We used a tiny GH Action to gate: it checks for approvals from CODEOWNERS, the label, and a set of passing checks. If any name differs it fails fast.

Mike: Example of the check matcher in our action:
```yaml
required_checks:
  - name: \"docs/preview\"
  - name: \"linter\"
  - name: \"spellcheck\"
```
If your preview job is emitting \"ci/docs-preview\" that will be ignored.

Lina: For CODEOWNERS, remember patterns are literal. We recently added a rule that excludes the /examples/ directory from auto-merge to force a human spot-check. Check this snippet:
```
# CODEOWNERS
/docs/ @docs
/examples/ @eng @docs-review
```

Sam: So next steps: Emma, add the \"docs:automerge\" label and I can flip the preview check name to the canonical \"docs/preview\" in the workflow. If rebase is a problem, click the \"Update branch\" button or I'll handle it.

Emma: Adding label now. @Lina thanks for the examples note — I actually touched examples so that explains it.

deploy-bot: [status] docs/preview: pending · spellcheck: success · linter: success

Mike: If we want to avoid this friction long-term we should: 1) normalize check names in the GH Actions repo, 2) add a short README in .github/ explaining required labels and 3) maybe make the bot comment which exact check names it expects when it blocks.

Lina: +1 on the bot comment. Even a tiny message like \"auto-merge blocked: expected check names [docs/preview, spellcheck, linter]\" would save a few tickets.

Emma: OK I've added the label and pushed a tiny fix to the preview job name. PTAL @Mike.

Mike: Got it — I retriggered the checks. If they pass the auto-merge queue should pick it up in ~1 minute.

deploy-bot: [status] docs/preview: success · spellcheck: success · linter: success

Emma: Looks like it merged — thanks all! :tada:

Sam: Filing a tiny docs PR to .github/ explaining the required label + check names. I'll cc @platform to consider adding the bot message.

Lina: Thanks — can you add a short migration note for folks who have examples changes? Remind them to request a human spot-check or remove the examples exemption if they add a migration guide.

Emma: Will do. Closing the loop here.
